summary: A user lost about 62000 dollars in USDC after an attacker exploited a malicious Permit approval signed 779 days earlier and never revoked. The same approval had previously enabled the theft of about 100000 USDC from the wallet.
user_mistake: left a previously signed malicious token approval active
prevention: Revoke token approvals after completing interactions with unfamiliar applications / Review existing approvals before transferring new assets into a previously used wallet
